1.description: [Elune] - Increased base damage and scaling of Rupture by 30%. (This will come to Area 52 at a later date, accompanied by other balance changes required).
[Elune] - Bathe in Blood now further increases the damage of your Rouge bleed effects by 6% per stack. Up from 4% per stack.
[Elune] - Razzashi Talon now gets its damage increase by your bleeds on the target by 10%. Up to maximum of 70%. Down from 100% maximum.
[Elune] - Bloody Strikes now increases the damage of your Mutilate and Razzashi Talon by 15% per stack and your Titanic Mutilate by 10% per stack.
[Elune] - Increased proc chance of Overload Mastery to 15%. Up from 11%.
[Elune] - Increased base damage and scaling of Earthpulse Agony by 10%.
[Elune] - Cloudburst now increases the cast time of Thunderstorm by 1 second. Down from 1.5 seconds.
[Elune] - Druidic Overload now increases the damage of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Thunderstorm by 25%. Up from 15% just for Lightning Bolt nad Chain Lightning.

[Elune] - Scorched Ground now has a new mechanic: Dealing damage over time with Living bomb against monsters has a 15% chance to make your next Hot Streak have 2 charges. This can not occur more than once every 6 seconds.
[Elune] - Chain Reaction from Critical Time now increases damage of the final explosion of Living bomb by 25%. Up from 15%.

[Elune] - Hot Hands now further increases the damage of your Pyroblast against monsters 20%.This effect does not further increase the damage of Arctis and Fuego. This previously decreased the damage Pyroblast against monsters by 10%.

[Elune] - Brand of the Pyromaniac now has a new mechanic: While Pyroblast is still in the air, your next Fire Blast critical strike will trigger empowered Ignite, causing the target to burn for an additional 100% of its damage. This does not work while Fuego or Arctis are in the air. (This means that if your regular ignite would deal 30% additional damage, it will deal 130% through the usage of this mechanic)
[Elune] - Brand of the Pyromaniac now makes your next two Pyroblasts to bounce to nearby enemies. Up from only one next Pyroblast.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Elune] Eye Beam of C'thun now deals fixed base damage. The new damage is slightly reduced of the previous average cast.
